content.title: Geist font dependency is imported nowhere in webapp
content.description: @fontsource-variable/geist is listed in packages/webapp/frontend/package.json dependencies but is never imported in src/ (no import of '@fontsource-variable/geist' anywhere). As a result the intended Geist font is not loaded and the UI falls back to the browser default. To fix: import the font in src/main.tsx (e.g. import '@fontsource-variable/geist') and set the font-family in the base layer / body styles. Discovered while fixing the shadcn theme tokens (mqgzae4ayr) — cosmetic, out of scope there.
